specification.outcome: A normal conversational request can create an ordinary unclaimed Backlog task without a campaign or starting work.

scenarios.name: create an ordinary task
given: The signed task board is writable
The request supplies valid task metadata
when: Pi submits the create-task workflow request
then: One ordinary task is published in Backlog
The task is unspecified and unclaimed
No campaign, readiness, claim, worktree, or run effect occurs

scenarios.name: reject unavailable publication
given: The signed task board is read-only
when: Pi submits the create-task workflow request
then: The existing task-board failure is returned
No task or campaign effect occurs

acceptanceCriteria: The workflow request accepts a title and description through existing task value parsers.
The host generates task event authority values and publishes through the existing signed task remote.
Success reports the created task identity and projected Backlog, unspecified, and unclaimed state.
exclusions: Automatically reviewing, claiming, or starting the created task
dependencies: Existing task value parsers, TaskCreatedEvent projection, and signed GitTaskRemote publication
specification.architectureImplications: Extend the closed workflow request dispatcher while preserving the functional-core and signed-publication boundaries.
